reflections.summary: Won decisively by Mega Evolving Charizard-Y on Turn 1 to activate Drought, which overwrote the opponent's rain and neutralized their Swampert/Basculegion rain core. Sun-boosted Solar Beam from Charizard and Mamoswine's Ice/Earthquake coverage dismantled three opponent Pokémon (Swampert, Basculegion, Archaludon) by Turn 4. The opponent's rain offense was crippled before it could function, and their remaining Pelipper was reduced to 34% and unable to break through Protect-cycling.
reflections.adjustment: Mamoswine died to rain-boosted Weather Ball on Turn 4 after already being chipped to 44%. Against a known rain core, consider pivoting Mamoswine out earlier once its Ice Shard speed-control role is served (Turn 1), rather than leaving it in to absorb repeated super-effective Water attacks. Also, Charizard's Focus Blast miss on Turn 3 was an unnecessary risk — Solar Beam or Fire Blast would have been safer while maintaining offensive pressure.
reflections.notebook: Opponent runs a rain core: Pelipper (DampRock, Tailwind, Protect-stall), Swampert-Mega, Basculegion (SwiftSwim, Mystic Water). Archaludon is a Stamina+SitrusBerry tank/charger used to absorb hits and set up. Raichu and Tsareena were on the preview but not revealed — treat as potential surprise picks next game. Charizard-Mega-Y with Drought is the correct Mega choice against this opponent; it shuts down rain entirely. Pelipper at 34% with DampRock remains — plan Knock Off or Fire Blast to finish if it switches in next game. Excadrill Mold Breaker remains reserved for Stamina threats but was not needed this game.

reflections.summary: The opponent's Mega Charizard-Y completely neutralized rain with Drought on turn one, punishing Swampert and Basculegion with super-effective Solar Beams while Mamoswine picked off key threats. Bringing a pure rain-dependent core against Charizard-Y backfired immediately.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Archaludon and backline support earlier rather than locking into a double Swift Swim rain core that crumbles instantly when weather is overridden by Charizard.
